package.name: kin5axcam
package.description: A 3D Surface (5axis) operation for the CAM workbench: a zigzag over the parameter space of one face, cut with any shape of tool. The path carries the tip of the tool, worked out from the roundness at the end of it. The tool stands up, or points along the surface normal leaned over by two angles, and then every cutting move carries the axis of the tool as I, J and K - the vector output the kin5ax postprocessor solves for.

workbench.description: Adds the command CAM_Surface5Axis to the CAM workbench. It is not a workbench of its own.
